She is the daughter of [[Lucius]] and [[Rystal]], the mother of [[Diana]] and in turn [[Lucca]]'s grandmother and [[Liko]]'s great-grandmother. ==History== [[File:Layla.png|thumb|left|250px|Layla as an adult (right) looking for her daughter [[Diana]]]] ===Pre-series=== Diana revealed that Layla was orphaned at a very young age, which meant she had little contact with her family history. ===''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''=== In ''[[HZ024|Reunion at the Ancient Castle!]]'', she was seen searching for her daughter in a flashback moments before Diana found the mysterious pendant that she would give to Liko years in the future. In ''[[HZ074|The Three Explorers]]'' and ''[[HZ075|The Wonders of the World!]]'', she was summoned as a baby by {{TP|Liko|Terapagos}} at the [[Crystal Pool]] alongside her mother, Rystal.
